en.answer: Even if only <<10004>> is on the field, the Xyz Material detached as the cost to activate the effect of <<10004>> can be selected as the target of the effect of <<10004>>.
en.question: When there's only <<10004>> on the field, can the Xyz Material that's detached as the cost to activate the effect of <<10004>> be selected as the target of the effect of this <<10004>>?
en.title: Can the Xyz Material detached as the cost to activate the effect of <<10004>> be selected as the target of the effect?

ja.answer: フィールド上に「<<10004>>」のみが存在する場合であっても、「<<10004>>」の効果を発動するためのコストとして取り除いたエクシーズ素材を、「<<10004>>」の効果の対象として選択する事はできます。
